note: The repo scripts are bash: Git Bash is put first on PATH and a python3 copy is created inside the venv (the Windows python3 is a Store stub). Endpoint VMs (blue + green) bill while they exist: do the endpoint screen in one short sitting and tear down at once. A rejected model or a failed job is the episode. The studio views are in each screen's 'also'. ci/mlops.yml is shown, never run.
prepare: $env:PATH = "C:\Program Files\Git\bin;$env:PATH"   # bash = Git Bash, not the WSL launcher
# owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-14 -l westeurope -o none

$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-14 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'deployment to rg-mglab-ai-14 failed' }
python -m slabreach generate --out build/raw   # dry run: also builds and caches the environment image
